title: Tugas MLOps
summary: A university MLOps course project that builds a gender-classification pipeline (Logistic Regression / Gaussian Naive Bayes) deployed with Gradio on Hugging Face Spaces, with monitoring via Prometheus/Grafana and DVC for data versioning. Its data_drift.py script uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit a synthetic model on the dataset and sample synthetic rows for drift simulation.
evidence: src/data_drift.py:21-23: model = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata); model.fit(data); synthetic = model.sample(num_rows=len(data))
